condition: For Array columns whose null rows come from a gather or outer/right join, arr.get/arr.first/arr.max read the values hidden under the null row (e.g. 0.0) and return them instead of null.
workaround: Mask the result back to null where the source array is null, e.g. pl.when(pl.col("arr").is_not_null()).then(pl.col("arr").arr.get(1)).
